notes: A hand-written fake model output, not a real writer's: the Hindi lines are English glosses keyed en-IN, and stand_in.english_words names the words a Hindi line would have left in English letters. Replace it with a live run's (--import-live).

script.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, this is Neha from Suraksha Insurance Advisors, about your motor policy. Can you talk now?

stages.name: Tell the expiry
stages.instruction: Tell them their motor policy expires within 30 days, then ask for the vehicle number to confirm the policy.

scripts.en-IN: Your motor policy expires this month. Can you tell me your vehicle number?

branches.when: They sold the vehicle or are not interested

stages.name: Ask to renew
stages.instruction: Ask whether they want to renew the policy with us.

scripts.en-IN: Would you like to do the renewal with us?

branches.when: They do not want to renew

stages.name: Ask what changed
stages.instruction: Ask whether their address changed or they made a claim this year.

scripts.en-IN: Has your address changed, or did you make a claim this year?

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Tell them an advisor will send the renewal quote and call them to finish it, then thank them.

scripts.en-IN: Our advisor will send you the quote and call you. Thank you.

step_outcomes.outcome: The person knows the policy expires soon.
The person says whether they want to renew.
Any change of address or claim is known.
The person knows an advisor will call.
